edit_chain.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the existing five-view sheet to correct. Produce a full edited sheet of the SAME toy. Preserve the established layout and identity.

Replace the upper two views with physically correct orthographic lateral elevations: top row VEHICLE-RIGHT nose RIGHT; second row VEHICLE-LEFT nose LEFT. Camera precisely perpendicular to the doors, at mid-door height, horizontal, ZERO pitch/yaw/roll. Do NOT copy the current elevated angle.
In each side row: no broad roof, hood/cowl, rear-deck or wing TOP surface; only curved edge contours. No downward view into seat cushions. No front grille/bumper FACE or rear lamp-panel FACE: those planes collapse edge-on. Rotate the camera; do NOT erase graphics or squash body height. Wing supports and near/far wheels align in projection. Circular near wheel faces, level axle baseline. Preserve actual roof height, hood slope, wheelbase, ride height, wheel size, fender overlap and body shape.
Also correct the bottom FRONT and REAR cameras to horizontal orthographic elevations at mid-body height, rather than looking down: roof and horizontal hood/deck surfaces seen as narrow contours, no large top planes. Keep genuine sloping surfaces and material depth.
Keep the true overhead panel facing right, its artwork and proportions, except the specifically requested corrections below.

CAR-SPECIFIC INVARIANTS
Turquoise metallic 1993 Mustang Cobra R HGK61, pale blue cabin, black ten-spoke wheels with chrome rim lips, black side-window trim, Cobra fender badges, normal readable MUSTANG quarter-window marks. Square fuel flap ONLY on vehicle-RIGHT, top row. Opposite side has none. Hood must be fully shut, flush rear edge and no opening gap in ALL views; keep raised central hood molding only where real. Preserve the rear wing silhouette but hide its top surface in both side rows. Dual rear exhaust and KOIBRA plate unchanged.

Photographic physical die-cast miniature: retain rounded metallic highlights, recessed wheel spokes, rubber tire volume, glazing thickness and cabin depth. Orthographic camera must NOT produce flat vector/sprite materials.
Exactly five complete silhouettes in four rows, equal scale for the two sides and overhead, equal width/scale front/rear, generous white gutters. Do not crop tires or wings. Opaque pure WHITE #FFFFFF outside the silhouettes, no floor, cast/contact shadows, halos or floor reflections. No text labels, packaging, borders or sixth panel.

Edit the supplied five-view sheet. Replace ONLY the top two side views. Keep the lower three views, layout and colors unchanged.

The two side views must become TRUE ENGINEERING SIDE ELEVATIONS rendered in photographic materials. Top row nose RIGHT, second row nose LEFT. Move the cameras DOWN to axle-center height and aim EXACTLY HORIZONTALLY across the car, perpendicular to the doors, with orthographic projection. Zero downward tilt and zero front-corner reveal. A headlamp or front-bumper FACE must collapse to a thin edge at the nose. The front and rear planes have ZERO visible width in a lateral elevation. Do not just paint over their markings.
The hood/cowl, roof, rear deck and wing TOPS must collapse to thin contours. NO transverse roof/hood bands, NO top-facing hood artwork, NO windshield width, NO looking down into the cabin. Near/far wing supports and wheels align in projection. The body remains its real full height and width: change ONLY the virtual camera, never squash the body or lower the roof.

Keep the photographic metal gradients, glass, rubber, tire thickness and recessed spokes. Preserve the toy's actual wheelbase, fenders, wheel diameters, stance, sculpted side details and all side graphics. Do not substitute a flat illustration. Do not mirror one side to make the other.
Turquoise metallic 1993 Mustang Cobra R HGK61, pale blue cabin, black ten-spoke wheels with chrome rim lips, black side-window trim, Cobra fender badges, normal readable MUSTANG quarter-window marks. Square fuel flap ONLY on vehicle-RIGHT, top row. Opposite side has none. Hood must be fully shut, flush rear edge and no opening gap in ALL views; keep raised central hood molding only where real. Preserve the rear wing silhouette but hide its top surface in both side rows. Dual rear exhaust and KOIBRA plate unchanged.
Keep exactly five full views in four rows. All exterior space pure white with no ground/contact/cast shadows or halos. No labels. Output the corrected full sheet.
